rows.en: Touya: "...Aaah... Finally over!"
Yamato: "Opening your mouth that wide is bad manners."
Touya: "What do you expect? Listening to a speech that long
would make anyone sleepy. Still, why do the big shots
always talk for so long?"
Yamato: "What are you talking about?
You barely listened to any of it..."
Lodis: "It's true. The higher one's social standing,
the longer one's speeches tend to be."
Yamato: "Oh, Lodis! And Prince Tix..."
Lodis: "...We were able to reach this day
because of your efforts.
On behalf of the people, thank you."
Touya: "That's not true. We were only
the spark. You, Lodis, and all the people here
worked hard to make it happen."
Lodis: "Ha ha ha. You're modest.
Some people see you as a hero for piloting Rayblade and defeating Goderius,
you know."
Touya: "Heroes are just illusions people create.
Everyone's special."
Lodis: "I see. There's truth in that."
Tix: "...The war is over, and the ≪Ze=Ode≫
have fallen. But... Is everything really over now?"
Yamato: "Dr. Debish vanished along with Goderius.
I'm sure it'll be all right."
Lodis: "Probably.
But there's one thing that concerns me."
Touya: "Something concerns you?"
Lodis: "Eleana has disappeared."
Yamato: "What?! D-Don't tell me... Leone too...?"
Lodis: "No. Leone is in the infirmary.
Only Eleana has vanished without a trace."
Touya: "Then you're saying Eleana moved on its own?"
Lodis: "I don't know. All we know is that it's gone.
I hope nothing comes of it..."
Yamato: "Then what about Rayblade?"
Lodis: "There don't seem to have been any abnormalities.
As planned, we'll begin dismantling it tomorrow
and seal the 'Core.'"
Lodis: "All that remains is to dismantle Rayblade
and seal the 'Core.'"
Yamato: "So you're dismantling Rayblade."
Touya: "Then you're done analyzing it?"
Lodis: "Yes, we've finished for now.
First, only someone with Lenis Enroad's genetic information
can start it.
And through synchronicity with a compatible person of the opposite sex,
it can finally be fully activated."
Yamato: "I see. The 'red thread of fate,' huh?"
Lodis: "Ha ha ha. Perhaps.
But that isn't the only reason we decided to dismantle it.
Even if you, its only pilot, return to your own world,
leaving it here might lead someone in a later age,
even if not us, to consider using it for war.
We need to act before that happens."
Touya: "My own world...? We can go back?"
Lodis: "If Dr. Wenimas's aim was to stop Debish,
then now that you've fulfilled that purpose,
your existence probably won't become unstable even if you return."
Touya: "'Probably'...?"
Lodis: "Well, if it doesn't work, you can always come back here.
You'll be welcome."
Touya: "Hey, come on..."
Lodis: "Ha ha ha, I'm joking. We're preparing the equipment
to get you home safely. I'll take responsibility for it. Don't worry.
You should be able to return tomorrow.
The others should have received the same explanation."
Yamato: "I see... So it's finally time to say goodbye to this place."
Tix: "So relax and enjoy today... Though
I suppose it's not my place to say that."
Touya: "Of course it is. Yeah, I'll enjoy myself."
Sisk: "Your Highness!"
Lodis: "Ghh... Th-That voice..."
Sisk: "Your Hiiighness! Where are you?"
Lodis: "W-Well, then, if you'll excuse me..."
Sisk: "There! Found you, Your Highness♥
Aaah! Why are you running away?! Your Highness!"
Tix: "Maybe it's about time my brother settled down."
Touya: "You seem happy about it."
Tix: "Of course. What younger brother wouldn't be happy for his older brother?"
Touya: "An older brother... Yeah, you're right."
Tix: "Yes. Well, I'd better excuse myself
too. See you later..."
Yamato: "Well, we can't just stand around here doing nothing.
Let's walk a little."
Touya: "L-Leone... Are you all right?"
Leone: "...Yes, I'm fine. I feel really good
today. Besides, Bart went to all that trouble
to get this ready for me..."
Yamato: "It suits you very well. Right, Touya?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah. You look good dressed like that too."
Leone: "Ehehe. Thank you.
...It makes me happy to hear you say that..."
Touya: "H-Hey, are you really all right?
You're unsteady on your feet... Don't push yourself..."
Leone: "...Yes. Sorry for worrying you.
But... I want to spend as much time with everyone as I can..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "...I told you, I'm all right.
...Come on. More importantly, Touya, there's someone else
you ought to be worrying about, isn't there?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Leone: "...The person you care about, Touya.
Don't worry about me. Go and find her."
Touya: "But I said I'd wait here..."
Leone: "Touya. A girl is happiest
when she feels the person she loves cares about her. I'm sure she's waiting for you, Touya,
to come and see her."
Touya: "Is that how it works? Still, I never expected you
to know so much about that."
Leone: "...Huh? Now that you mention it...
Bernst must have put that knowledge into me."
Touya: "Oh... Sorry..."
Leone: "No, don't worry. Knowing those things
let me feel this way. To learn how wonderful
it is to love someone..."
Touya: "Leone..."
Leone: "Oh, wh-what am I saying...?
Well, I'll be going now.
I'd like to talk to everyone else too..."
Leone: "...Huh? Now that you mention it...
...I wonder why...? Hmm... Well, I am
a girl, after all."
Touya: "Well, that's true.
...So what are you going to do?"
Leone: "Huh? Me? I've seen you, Touya, so...
I'll go find everyone else."
Yamato: "Huh? You haven't seen them yet?"
Leone: "No. I wanted to see you first, Touya...
Oh, d-don't read too much into it!
W-Well, I'll be going. Bye-bye!"
Touya: "Leone..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya. She was acting cheerful,
but she was really pushing herself.
It looked like she was hiding the pain behind a smile."
Touya: "Yeah... She probably didn't want us to worry...
That's just like her..."
Yamato: "Let's not waste Leone's kindness.
Shall we go find her...?"
Touya: "Yeah, you're right..."
Go somewhere with fewer people.
Go somewhere with lots of people.
Stay where you are.
Fores: "Oh..."
Touya: "You're... Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual, right?"
Fores: "I'm honored you remember me..."
Yamato: "Huh? You seem a little different..."
Touya: "Maybe it's because her hair's down?"
Yamato: "Hmm... There's something... alluring about her,
a kind of feminine softness..."
Fores: "Am I being complimented?"
Yamato: "Y-Yes!"
Touya: "...Huh? Come to think of it, where's that guy
who was always with you?"
Fores: "...He... That fool... is dead..."
Yamato: "What?!"
Fores: "...In my arms..."
Touya: "I-I see... I'm sorry."
Fores: "His body was already in ruins...
And I couldn't do anything
for him, right to the end..."
Touya: "...I don't think that's true."
Fores: "Huh?"
Touya: "He looked really happy when he was with you.
Well, I didn't know him that long,
but that's how it looked to me."
Fores: "...Yes. He told me he loved me,
even though I'm a dull woman who only knows her duty...
I regret not answering him sooner."
Touya: "But Reamond breathed his last
in your arms, right?"
Fores: "Yes... It was as if he were going to sleep."
Touya: "Then he must have been happy. He was able to spend
his final moments in the arms of the person he loved.
It sounds trite, but you've got to live for Reamond too,
and find happiness.
I think that's what Reamond would want."
Fores: "Heh heh... You're right.
Besides... Perhaps this parting is only temporary..."
Touya: "Hmm? Why are you holding your stomach? Does it hurt?"
Fores: "No, it's nothing.
Well, I'll excuse myself."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "...Maybe Reamond didn't die,
but 'returned' instead..."
Touya: "Hmm? What do you mean?"
Yamato: "Nothing.
Anyway, let's go somewhere else."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "Hmm? This looks like the same scenery as before..."
Yamato: "Does it? I'm sure it's your imagination. Yes."
Touya: "You think so...? ...Hmm?"
Yamato: "Huh? Isn't that General Growster?"
Touya: "What's he looking at with that glass in his hand?"
Yamato: "That's the direction of Agarthia's royal capital..."
Growster: "Dilma...
It's the 15-year-old Raidol you liked..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency. The night air isn't good for your health..."
Growster: "...He was a stubborn, inflexible man,
but he finally rose to the rank of marshal... And died..."
Adjutant: "..."
Growster: "If he'd waited a little longer, I'd have caught up...
Selfish to the very end."
Adjutant: "Marshal Revios... He was your close friend, wasn't he?"
Growster: "Hmph! That man was no friend of mine!
Not someone who couldn't even keep a promise..."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency..."
Yamato: "He looks rather serious...
We'd better leave him alone."
Touya: "Yeah... We'd better go somewhere else."
Yamato: "Oh... Isn't that..."
Touya: "Ugh, that old man again."
Yamato: "That hat should signify an Alchemist's rank.
A very high one, too... Maybe Dr. Berol
is actually someone quite remarkable..."
Assistant: "Doctooor!"
Murk: "Hey, don't run so much.
Especially in a place like this..."
Assistant: "O-Oww..."
Murk: "I told you...
Honestly, you're such a scatterbrain...
Come on, can you get up?"
Assistant: "Huh? Your face looks blurry, Doctor."
Murk: "You fool. Your glasses have fallen off."
Assistant: "Oh..."
Murk: "...Honestly. You need to do something about that clumsiness first.
And you're a young woman now. You should pay a little more attention
to your appearance, you know."
Assistant: "I'm sorry... You went to all that trouble
to get me this dress, and I've dirtied it..."
Murk: "Never mind that.
But can't you at least be ladylike when you're wearing a dress?
Even to an old man like me, you look quite good.
If you made an effort, you'd have the men around here falling at your feet.
Well, your lack of awareness is the problem..."
Assistant: "O-Oh..."
Murk: "Well, never mind. ...Now, we've eaten our fill.
It's about time we went back to the laboratory."
Assistant: "Huh? A-Already?"
Murk: "No back talk.
Come on, Marsha!"
Assistant: "!!"
Murk: "...What's wrong? Wh-Why are you crying?!"
Assistant: "Y-You called me by my proper name..."
Murk: "D-Did I?
Oh, don't cry over something like that!
If you're not coming, I'll leave you behind!"
Marsha: "Oh, p-please wait!
I'm coming! I'm coming!"
Yamato: "...There they go."
Touya: "Well, there's no point staying here...
Let's go somewhere else..."
Yamato: "Huh? What's that crowd of people...?"
Touya: "Who knows? More importantly..."
Rishuna: "I-I'm sorry... Oh."
Touya: "Hey, Rishuna. What's wrong?"
Rishuna: "I don't like being surrounded by people..."
Yamato: "Then that crowd..."
Rishuna: "Yes. Valga is being bombarded with questions now.
Our true identities haven't been made public, but people do know we're Shinkaio
pilots..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, I saw Ymir just now.
She looked rather troubled..."
Touya: "Ymir did? Do you know where she went?"
Rishuna: "She was walking toward the fountain..."
Yamato: "Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Ymir."
Ymir: "Oh... Touya... How did you...?"
Touya: "Rishuna told me."
Ymir: "I see..."
Touya: "...What's wrong? You seem down."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Ymir...?"
Ymir: "...You're... going home tomorrow, aren't you?"
Touya: "Yeah... I haven't decided for certain yet,
but I suppose I'll end up going back..."
Ymir: "...Of course.
I should've known that...
But... When I heard it, I was so terribly
sad...
Tell me, Touya... Are we saying goodbye tonight...?
I don't... I don't want that..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "...I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to make things difficult for you, Touya... But..."
Touya: "...Don't worry. I'll come back."
Ymir: "Huh...?"
Touya: "I want to be with you too, Ymir.
But just as you, Ymir, have people waiting for you here,
I have friends worrying about me back there.
It might be dull, but there's a warm everyday life waiting for me."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "So I'll explain things to them properly, then come back.
I promise I'll return... Will you wait for me until then?"
Ymir: "Y-Yes... I'll wait...
I'll wait for you to come back, Touya."
Touya: "...I'm sorry."
Ymir: "...No."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...H-Hey, Touya..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Ymir: "Y-Yes... Um, I have a favor to ask..."
Touya: "If it's something I can do, sure."
Ymir: "Well... While I wait for you to return, Touya...
So I won't forget you, Touya... Would you give me..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!! Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Ymir: "N-No... It can't be..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, have you seen Ai?"
Touya: "Huh? No, not since the party began.
Why?"
Rishuna: "Actually, she left this with me..."
Touya: "Hmm? What's this...? A note?"
Yamato: "Hey, hey, what does it say?"
Touya: "Let's see... 'I'll be waiting at the fountain.'"
Yamato: "...And?"
Touya: "That's all. What on earth is she trying to do?"
Yamato: "...Why don't we go and find out?"
Touya: "Yeah, you've got a point.
...Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Huh?! O-Okay..."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "...Ai."
Ai: "Oh..."
Touya: "What's wrong?
You didn't have to do something so roundabout..."
Ai: "I thought I'd rehearse a little.
I wondered what it'd feel like
to meet up with a boy I like."
Touya: "You..."
Ai: "Hey, Touya. Remember yesterday's promise?"
Touya: "Yeah. I remember.
We promised to meet again when we got back, right?"
Ai: "Not just meet. A date.
It'll be my slightly belated dating debut,
so you'd better keep your promise."
Touya: "Yeah, I know.
But you went to all that trouble just to say that?"
Ai: "Well, yes. But... I thought maybe
we could jump the gun a little..."
Touya: "???"
Ai: "I mean..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!! Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Ai: "Th-That..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, Kasumi was looking
for you earlier."
Touya: "Huh? We must have missed each other..."
Rishuna: "She was walking toward the fountain.
She may still be there if you go now."
Touya: "I see. Got it.
...Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Huh?! O-Okay..."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Kasumi."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya!
Where have you been? I was looking for you."
Touya: "Yeah, sorry."
Kasumi: "...But I'm glad I found you..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "...I-It's quiet, isn't it...?"
Touya: "Yeah. But it's a good place
to be alone together, isn't it?"
Kasumi: "...You're right.
Hey, Touya. Want to sit down for a bit?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "...So it's finally tomorrow."
Touya: "Yeah. A lot happened, but it's time to say goodbye to this place."
Kasumi: "...Yes. It was hard,
but living here was fun too...
Will we go back to our usual lives when we return?"
Touya: "Probably."
Kasumi: "...It's a little sad."
Touya: "But our relationship has changed, hasn't it?"
Kasumi: "Our relationship... Yes, it has.
...Hey, Touya..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Kasumi: "Thank you... for falling in love with me."
Touya: "I didn't fall in love with you. I've always loved you."
Kasumi: "Hee hee... You're right.
I love you too... Now, and from now on... Always."
Touya: "Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!! Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Kasumi: "It can't be..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, I saw Celica earlier.
She looked rather troubled..."
Touya: "Celica did? Do you know where she went?"
Rishuna: "She was walking toward the fountain..."
Yamato: "Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Celica."
Celica: "Oh..."
Touya: "So this is where you were.
...What's wrong?"
Celica: "Touya... Is it true you're going home tomorrow?"
Touya: "...Y-Yeah. I haven't decided for certain yet,
but I suppose I'll end up going back..."
Celica: "I see..."
Touya: "Celica..."
Celica: "Touya... Is that what you want?"
Touya: "Huh...?"
Celica: "I see... So you're all right with that.
You said you loved me, but it was a lie..."
Touya: "Hey..."
Celica: "It must've been! How can you say you're going home?!
If you loved me, you couldn't do that, could you?
I... I don't want to be separated from you, Touya!"
Touya: "It's not as if we're parting for the rest of our lives..."
Celica: "How... How can you say that?!
Once you go back to your world... It won't be that easy
to come here again..."
Touya: "Celica..."
Celica: "No! Don't touch me!
Touya, you... Touya, you..."
Touya: "...I didn't fall in love with you on a whim, Celica.
That's not how I feel."
Celica: "You're lying!"
Touya: "I'm not. Why won't you believe me?
What's wrong? This isn't like you."
Celica: "I never thought... I'd say things like this either.
But I can't help it..."
Touya: "Celica, listen to me..."
Celica: "...It's fine... Forget it..."
Touya: "Wait!"
Celica: "No! Let go!"
Touya: "Listen to me!"
Celica: "Enough! I don't want to listen!"
Touya: "..."
Celica: "Wh-What...?! ...Mmph..."
Touya: "...Do you still not believe me?"
Celica: "..."
Touya: "Celica?"
Celica: "...That's not fair. If you do that,
I can't stay angry anymore..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...I really do love you, Touya...
I can't dislike you... I don't want to say goodbye...
But... I don't want you to dislike me, Touya..."
Touya: "...So when did I say I wasn't coming back?"
Celica: "...Huh?"
Touya: "I told you my feelings weren't just a whim,
didn't I? I'll go back, explain things properly
to the people waiting for me, then come here again."
Celica: "R-Really?"
Touya: "Yeah. I promise."
Celica: "...Thank goodness...
...I'm sorry. I'm being awful, aren't I...?"
Touya: "Of course not."
Celica: "Hey... Once more..."
Touya: "No."
Celica: "Aww, why?"
Touya: "Let's save the rest for when I come back.
It'll give us more to look forward to, right?"
Celica: "Look forward to...? Oh, Touya..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!! Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Celica: "Huh...? No..."
Aurelie: "...Touya, got a moment?"
Touya: "Oh, Aurelie. What's wrong?"
Aurelie: "...Just a moment."
Touya: "Y-Yeah. Well, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Huh?! Y-Yeah..."
Rishuna: "Huh? Aren't you going with them?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time."
Rishuna: "I see... You're being a good big sister."
Yamato: "You could say that."
Touya: "Hey, where are we going?"
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Hello?"
Touya: "...Hmm? A fountain... It's quiet here."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Hey, what's wrong?"
Aurelie: "...I suddenly got worried..."
Touya: "Worried?"
Aurelie: "You're going back tomorrow too, right, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh...? Y-Yeah... Probably."
Aurelie: "We're in the same place now,
but when we return, I'll be in France. You'll be in Japan, Touya..."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "It's a long way."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Aurelie: "Hey, why don't we stay here?
We've got a place here too,
and there's nothing for us back..."
Touya: "Aurelie."
Aurelie: "What?"
Touya: "Don't say that.
Don't say something as sad as there being nothing for you."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "Sure, compared with life here,
our own world might be dull. But aren't there people there
who matter to you?"
Aurelie: "People who matter..."
Touya: "Yeah. The director of the orphanage where you grew up,
who raised you, and the children there...
You don't just not care about them, do you? Of course not."
Aurelie: "That's..."
Touya: "Going back doesn't mean we'll never meet again.
We'll be on the same Earth."
Aurelie: "But..."
Touya: "If we really love each other, distance doesn't matter.
Our hearts will be that much closer.
...I love you, Aurelie."
Aurelie: "Touya..."
Touya: "H-Hey, don't cling to me... Let go."
Aurelie: "...No."
Touya: "Hey..."
Aurelie: "I want to feel you close while I can, Touya.
Then I think I can bear it a little better."
Touya: "Aurelie..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble... Wah! Sorry..."
Touya: "Y-Yamato?! What happened...?"
Yamato: "Huh?! Oh! I said, there's trouble!!
...Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Aurelie: "No..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, I saw Melvi
earlier. She looked rather troubled..."
Touya: "Melvi did? Do you know where she went?"
Rishuna: "She was walking toward the fountain..."
Yamato: "Touya."
Touya: "Yeah. Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes... See you."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "...Melvi."
Melvi: "Oh... B-Big brother..."
Touya: "What are you doing here?"
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "Melvi?"
Melvi: "...Ugh... Uhh..."
Touya: "M-Melvi?!"
Melvi: "Uhh... Sniff... Sniff...
I-I'm sorry... When I saw your face, big brother... The tears..."
Touya: "Are you all right? What happened?"
Melvi: "...It's okay..."
Touya: "Why? I won't know unless you tell me, will I?"
Melvi: "But... I don't want you to dislike me, big brother."
Touya: "There's no way I'd dislike you, Melvi.
Tell me. It'll be all right."
Melvi: "Ugh... Really?"
Touya: "Really. So tell me."
Melvi: "...You know, Melvi loves you, big brother."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Melvi: "So... I don't want to say goodbye...
I promised it would only be while you're here, but..."
Touya: "Melvi..."
Melvi: "...But that's impossible, isn't it?
You're going home, big brother..."
Touya: "...Yeah..."
Melvi: "I see... Ehehe... Of course you are..."
Touya: "Melvi..."
Melvi: "N-No, it's fine. That's what we promised.
It was so sudden, it just surprised me a little..."
Touya: "...Melvi."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "...Hey, Melvi.
Just as there are people who care about you, Melvi,
here, I have people worrying about me
in my world. Coming here taught me even more
how precious those feelings are.
That's why I have to go back.
If I stayed here forever, I'd be betraying
those feelings. I can't do that."
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "...But Agarthia and our world
are connected, right? Then it doesn't mean
we'll never see each other again."
Melvi: "Y-Yeah... But..."
Touya: "Don't worry. Everyone's here in this world.
And of course, you're here too, Melvi.
So I'll come back someday, without fail. I promise."
Melvi: "...Really?"
Touya: "Yeah. I promise.
So smile like you always do. Okay?"
Melvi: "..."
Touya: "..."
Melvi: "Big brother, I looove you!"
Touya: "Ha ha ha! That's right.
That's more like you, Melvi..."
Melvi: "...Huh? What's that?"
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble... Wait, why are you
hugging at a time like this?!"
Melvi: "...Ehehehehe..."
Touya: "N-Never mind that. What happened?"
Yamato: "Huh?! Oh! I said, there's trouble!!
...Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Melvi: "B-Big brother... That..."
Rishuna: "Oh, more importantly, Melissa was looking
for you earlier."
Touya: "Huh? We must have missed each other..."
Rishuna: "She was walking toward the fountain.
She may still be there if you go now."
Touya: "I see. Got it.
...Thanks, Rishuna. See you later."
Rishuna: "Yes. Please be sure to accept
the feelings of the one who loves you."
Touya: "Huh?! O-Okay..."
Yamato: "Oh, there she is...
Look, in front of that fountain..."
Touya: "All right, let's go...? What's wrong, Yamato?"
Yamato: "...Go on your own, Touya."
Touya: "Yamato?"
Yamato: "I'll stay out of it this time.
Or are you nervous about going alone?"
Touya: "It's not that, but... All right.
I'll be back in a bit."
Yamato: "Okay."
Touya: "Melissa!"
Melissa: "Oh..."
Touya: "What are you doing here?"
Melissa: "Oh... Just thinking a little."
Touya: "Thinking?"
Melissa: "About what will happen to us now."
Touya: "What...? We'll go back to our own world... Oh."
Melissa: "See? Australia and Japan... It's a long way."
Touya: "But we'll be on the same Earth, right? It's not as if we can't meet."
Melissa: "...You're right. I think so too.
I don't want to think that distance could change these feelings."
Touya: "..."
Melissa: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Melissa: "So why don't we promise? That we'll definitely meet when we're back."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Of course."
Melissa: "It's a promise, okay?"
Touya: "Yeah. But how...?"
Melissa: "That's no problem. I've got a good idea."
Touya: "A-A good idea...?"
Melissa: "It's a seeecret♥"
Touya: "Huh? What's that supposed to mean?"
Melissa: "Hee hee... You save the fun for later.
It makes you that much happier."
Touya: "I don't really get it..."
Melissa: "...Huh? It's getting noisy..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Yamato... What happened?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!!
...Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Melissa: "Huh?! That... Surely not..."
Touya: "I see... That sounds rough."
Rishuna: "U-Um..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Rishuna: "If you don't mind, would you keep me company
for a little while?"
Touya: "Huh? Y-Yeah... I don't mind, but..."
Rishuna: "Then, this way..."
Touya: "H-Hey, you don't have to pull my hand.
I'll come with you..."
Yamato: "Oh, there they go..."
Rishuna: "...Phew. We should be safe here... Huh?
Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Hah... Hah... H-Hey, aren't you out of breath
after all that running?"
Rishuna: "No... Not at all."
Touya: "I-I see..."
Rishuna: "Um... Are you all right?
Could it be that you don't get enough exercise, Touya?"
Touya: "No. In this situation, I think it'd be more accurate
to say your stamina is bottomless, Rishuna..."
Rishuna: "Um... Would you like to sit there?"
Touya: "No... I'm fine. I've mostly caught my breath."
Rishuna: "I'm glad."
Touya: "...Phew...
...So what do we do now?"
Rishuna: "...What shall we do?"
Touya: "Hey, come on...
Did you just want to get away from that place?"
Rishuna: "Perhaps...
But I wanted to talk with you a little, Touya.
Isn't that a good enough reason?"
Touya: "That's fine, but... I'm not quite sure how to feel."
Rishuna: "If I upset you, I apologize.
I'm sorry."
Touya: "Oh, no, that's not it.
Well... Hmm... How should I put it...?"
Rishuna: "?"
Touya: "...Well, we haven't had much chance
to talk like this. Maybe it's just as well."
Rishuna: "...I'm glad."
Touya: "...So what did you want to talk about?"
Rishuna: "Um... I heard you and the others are going home tomorrow, Touya...
That's what I heard..."
Touya: "Yeah. I only just heard myself, and it surprised me.
Still, there's no need to rush back,
but I can't stay here forever."
Rishuna: "I see. Then tonight is our farewell..."
Touya: "Tonight? Are you going somewhere?
Oh... Back to your own planet, perhaps?"
Rishuna: "No. Lin Karma has already perished.
So, just as this Earth was, other planets are threatened by Vorlia,
and we intend to head for them."
Touya: "I see... Then we might never meet again."
Rishuna: "...Yes."
Touya: "You've been helping us all this time."
Rishuna: "Oh, no... We haven't done anything..."
Touya: "No. You were here for us.
That's how we made it this far. ...Thank you, Rishuna."
Rishuna: "Oh..."
Touya: "Hmm?"
Rishuna: "N-No...
...You're kind, aren't you?"
Touya: "You think so?"
Rishuna: "Yes. Very.
I want to know more about you..."
Touya: "Huh?! H-Hey...
You're so close..."
Rishuna: "...The highest token of friendship on our planet...
Do you know what it is...?"
Touya: "N-No..."
Rishuna: "...A way to know the other person better than you do now...
A very sacred ritual..."
Rishuna: "...?! Th-This feeling..."
Yamato: "Th-There's trouble!"
Touya: "Yamato... What happened?"
Yamato: "I said, there's trouble!!
...Look! Over there!"
Touya: "Over there...? What's in the sky...?!"
Rishuna: "Surely not... But why...?"
